2026 Hanno Genki Market and Nishikawa Timber Fair

Date and time: Sunday, March 8, 2026 (Reiwa 8), 9:30 a.m.–3:00 p.m. (held rain or shine)

Venue: Hanno Central Park (223-1 Hanno, Hanno City)

What to expect: Local products and food vendors, Nishikawa timber fair, karaoke contest, theater group and music department performances, outdoor stage, fire and police vehicle displays, inflatable dome, and more.

Important note: There is no parking available near the venue on the day. Please use public transportation or the shuttle bus running from Hanno City Hall.

Inquiries: Hanno Chamber of Commerce and Industry, 042-974-3111 (main line)

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2372/
